description: TrustAnchor and ValidationPolicy are public configuration types that callers will commonly want to inspect (Debug) and duplicate (Clone). Neither derives Clone or Debug. Their fields are x509_cert::name::Name (derives Clone, Debug) and spki::SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned (derives Clone, Debug) for TrustAnchor; and u8, u64, bool for ValidationPolicy — all Clone+Debug capable. Without Clone, callers building dynamic trust stores must reconstruct TrustAnchor from raw fields. Without Debug, error messages and test assertions cannot print the policy or anchor. Add #[derive(Clone, Debug)] to both types. Also add PartialEq to ValidationPolicy (all fields are PartialEq) since it's useful in tests.
title: Missing Clone and Debug derives on TrustAnchor and ValidationPolicy
